description: Completion of the Construction of the Four-Storied Building of the National Hospital, Kandy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-06-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - During the COVID-19 pandemic in 2021, a project for the construction of a pre‑fabricated four-storied building with 50 negative pressure isolation rooms for the Kandy National Hospital was initiated at an estimated cost of US$ 1.2 million (approximately Rs.236 million). The project was financed through a grant from the SAARC Development Fund. During the implementation of the project, the original scope of the project was revised to reduce the number of isolation rooms from 50 to 23, and to construct a 25-bed male ward and a 20-bed female ward, thereby increasing the total bed capacity from 50 to 68. Construction work worth Rs.282.24 million has been completed so far. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to revise the total cost estimate of the project to Rs.1,094.22 million and to extend the project period to 2027-12-31, to enable the completion of the project, was approved by the Cabinet.
